note: Only sources this lane READ. A file row names the file, the line and a text that must be on that line; a web row names the URL and the copy fetched into out/prior/ (2026-11-15) and a text that must be in that copy. guard.js check P fails a row whose text is not there. Nothing from memory.

items.name: iDempiere, the field tooltip
items.does: with a user preference on, adds the field's Entity Type: who owns it
items.took: the owner on every layer (base, plugin, rank)
items.does_zh: 打开用户偏好后，加上字段的实体类型：谁拥有它
items.took_zh: 每一层都标出所有者（基础、插件、等级）

items.name: iDempiere, Field Record Info
items.does: shows Table.Column='value' and the owner, not the code that runs
items.took: the code that runs, in firing order
items.does_zh: 显示 Table.Column='值' 和所有者，不显示运行的代码
items.took_zh: 按触发顺序列出运行的代码

items.name: Odoo developer mode
items.does: a per-session switch (?debug=1) that opens a field's technical data
items.took: a dev-only switch: a bookmark in one tab
items.does_zh: 按会话开启的开关（?debug=1），显示字段的技术数据
items.took_zh: 仅限开发的开关：一个标签页里的一个书签

items.name: click-to-component (React)

where.text: a Component in the browser to **instantly** goto the source in your editor

items.does: click a component, the editor opens on its source
items.took: Alt+n opens the line of layer n
items.does_zh: 点击一个组件，编辑器打开它的源代码
items.took_zh: Alt+n 打开第 n 层的那一行
